tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Financial Proposal shall be inclusive of all other applicable taxes payable by the Consultant (excluding Goods and Service Tax)
All other terms and conditions as per the tender bid document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultancy Firm Company JV partner should have been involved in the Marketing and Pre-Booking Sales Services in any of the Financial Year

The Consultancy Firm/Company/JV partner must have satisfactorily completed one single project of a similar nature of work, with a value not less than Rs. 400 Crores collectively, in any financial year from 2021-22 to 2025-26 Note: Tenders from Consortium (Limited to maximum of Three constituents including Prime/Lead Bidder)
Adequacy of the proposed work plan and methodology in responding to the ToR

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Adequacy of the proposed work plan and methodology in responding to the ToR

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultancy Firm / Company/ JV partner should have achieved at least in two Financial Years a minimum Financial Turnover of Rs.17.00 Crores out of the last five Financial Years (from 2021-22 to 2025-26) collectively. In support of this, the Consultant shall furnish the Audited Balance Sheets along with the Technical Proposal. Further, the Financial Turnover of the Previous Years shall be given a Weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the Price Level of 2026-27.Note: Tenders from Consortium (Limited to maximum of Three constituents including Prime/Lead Bidder)
